name: @sanmumu/dsh-doubao-client
description: Expose the models of a locally running Doubao desktop client as a DeepSeek Harness provider: all twelve catalog models in ordinary chat mode, real image input through the client's own upload channel, subscription quota query, a local character-based usage ledger, and strict-JSON tool emulation. Unofficial local integration over the client's loopback debugging port; never exports credentials, never enables the native task runtime.
author: sanmumu-325

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check adapter.js && node --check bridge.js && node --check renderer.js && node --test *.test.mjs
